findings.current: *“And you’ll find out what that thing is soon enough.”*
findings.defect: Quotation marks turn Jin’s thought about what he expects to learn into another line of the Demon Lord’s last message.
findings.rationale: The Demon Lord’s message has already ended; this is Jin’s own thought.
findings.replacement: *And I’d find out what that thing was soon enough.*
findings.source: ‘그리고 그 물건이 무엇인지는, 머지않아 곧 알게 되겠지.’

findings.current: His Highness the Crown Prince couldn’t come with me today, but I hope you know he feels the same way.
findings.defect: “Crown Prince” obscures the specified relationship: the designated heir is the Emperor’s younger brother.
findings.rationale: 황태제 identifies an imperial younger brother designated as heir, not the Emperor’s son.
findings.replacement: His Highness, the Emperor’s younger brother and heir, couldn’t come with me today, but I hope you know he feels the same way.
findings.source: 황태제(皇太弟) 전하께서도 같은 마음이시라는 걸 알아줬으면 해요.

findings.current: “So, Comrade Hong—no, Eunuch Hong—is the new head of the East Depot?”
findings.defect: The question drops the specific office, Cang Gong, which matters because Hong distinguishes holding that office from running the East Depot.
findings.rationale: The source asks whether Hong has become 창공, not merely whether he is in charge.
findings.replacement: “So, Comrade Hong—no, Eunuch Hong—have you become the East Depot’s new Cang Gong?”
findings.source: 그럼 홍 동지, 아니 홍 태감이 동창의 새로운 창공(廠公)이 된 겁니까?

findings.current: “I’m responsible for the East Depot, yes. But the position of its chief eunuch may remain vacant forever.
findings.defect: “Chief eunuch” replaces the named Cang Gong office and its specific Seal-Holding Eunuch title.
findings.rationale: Hong explicitly separates responsibility for the agency from the office of 창공, which he identifies as 장인태감.
findings.replacement: “I’m responsible for the East Depot, yes. But the position of Cang Gong—the Seal-Holding Eunuch—may remain vacant forever.
findings.source: 동창을 책임지고 있는 건 맞지만, 창공. 즉 장인태감이라는 지위는 영원히 공석일 가능성이 높아요.

findings.current: *Lastly, he could’ve used one of Dark Heaven’s Moving Formations, hidden somewhere nearby.*
findings.defect: “One of” and the plural add multiple nearby formations where the source posits a hidden formation.
findings.rationale: The Korean refers to a possible hidden 이동진 without asserting a group of them.
findings.replacement: *Lastly, he could’ve used a Moving Formation Dark Heaven had hidden somewhere nearby.*
findings.source: 주위 어딘가에 숨겨 둔 암천의 이동진(移動眞)을 이용했을 가능성도 있지.

findings.current: Ma Sanbao was still a Supreme Peak master and a monster with incredible powers of recovery.
findings.defect: “Supreme Peak master” loses the explicit point that Ma Sanbao had reached that realm.
findings.rationale: 초절정의 경지에 오른 states attainment of the Supreme Peak realm.
findings.replacement: Ma Sanbao had still reached the Supreme Peak realm and was a monster with incredible powers of recovery.
findings.source: 마삼보 역시 초절정의 경지에 오른 강자인 동시에 엄청난 회복력을 지닌 괴물이고

summary: Several actionable fidelity and terminology issues, including a thought misattributed to the dying speaker.
